query: SELECT year, month, campus, subgroup, SUM(total) as total, SUM(avgWeekly) as avgWeekly FROM attendance_monthly WHERE year = 2026 AND campus = 'Canton' AND subgroup IN ('Adults','Kids','Students','Young Adults') GROUP BY year, month, campus, subgroup ORDER BY month, subgroup;
